title: Per-step validation timing: on-blur before first submit, then on-change after the first failure, and a full pass on submit reusing the SPA forms-engine
description: Every step validates its own answers before advancing. Validation timing is on-blur before the first submit attempt on a step (a field validates when the operator leaves it), then on-change after the first submit failure on that field (so the operator sees the message clear as they correct it), and a full pass on submit that rebuilds the error set from scratch. Validation delegates to the SPA blueprint's forms-engine TAC-205 so a project already applying application-spa does not compose two overlapping engines. On refusal the engine surfaces the failed fields to the error-summary contract (REQ-003). The timing rule is a closed set at v1.0.0; different projects can elicit stricter (validate on every change from the start) via a project-level ADR but the shipped default is the three-mode rule above.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.3, REQ 2.
